objective: ONE historical OOS test before considering purchase of a MyFundedFutures $50k Rapid EOD evaluation; no mandatory live Sim101 stage
source_fingerprint_method: SHA256 of each full source file and its relative path sorted, then SHA256 canonical join; record in immutable manifest after synthetic CI
candles_or_tick_type: existing licensed NQ Last, atomic groups by identical timestamp for new models, original legacy T05 unchanged

single_account.conflict_priority: T05-377, T147, T186, T210, T212, T215, T217, T224 (from frozen original ORDER)
single_account.contract_sizing: Original 1 NQ or 1 MNQ selected by each frozen model; no retrospective size changes
single_account.slippage: Frozen per-model assumed 2 adverse ticks per side; include adversarial costs x1.5 and extra $10/round-trip without double-charging original fees

mandatory_final_report: date coverage & QC, rollover and timezone
all THREE policies with zero-trade days and parents attribution
base net and expectancy/trade, profit factor
stress net with x1.5 cost and extra $10 RT
drawdown closed EOD and conservative adverse Last path
rolling EOD floor crossing risk in evaluation and funded reset phase
monthly stability across July August September
delta A-vs-benchmark and B-vs-A on identical sessions with matched friction
bootstrap paired days IC90 and sample uncertainty with tiny holdout warning
NQ/MNQ sizes, ambiguous same-timestamp cases, known Bid/Ask unknowns
news/inactivity unknowns, all negative outcomes and no retro exclusions

hard_no_go_if: missing or invalid source quality, sessions/rollover
any OOS peek prior to final freeze
source SHA mismatch or runtime code different
execution ambiguity or missing entry/exit timestamps that prevents defensible risk measurement
any modeled evaluation/funded EOD floor breach under conservative Last bound
nonpositive profit under stress x1.5 or +$10RT
no modeled benefit relative to benchmark on same days and friction
inability to apply contemporaneous funded rules (mark eligibility NOT_ESTIMABLE instead of claiming GO)
further_evidence_required_before_go: risk-adjusted expectancy per trade and net/DD, PF, N and frequency
positive or explain negative monthly contributions without cherry picking
T215 incremental attribution and uncertainty, especially few OOS trades
margins to $2000 floor and limitation of last-only marks
review latest MFFU news, inactivity and implementation details before payment
decision_gates.statistical_evidence: report IC90 bootstrap days, p and uncertainty; 3-month holdout cannot by itself prove annual CAGR or independent robustness after 255 adaptive choices
decision_gates.winner_selection_rule: Compare both frozen candidates and T05 benchmark; do NOT pick the better one and then treat it as its own clean OOS; both are predeclared and require post-selection caution
decision_gates.if_both_fail: NO_GO; record holdout consumed, do not reoptimize on Jul-Sep or move calendar
